name: Caerulescent-Almagest
description: Water rules this world utterly, kilometers deep over drowned continents. Swells march in orderly regiments until they shatter against towering mountain ranges, and the spray smells of minerals and cold salt.

There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure. Fossil beds suggest rich seas once flourished here; now the chemistry records only a slow suffocation.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
For traders, fusion fuel alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
